_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_riot.py. t_riot_brute prints the keyword itself (the Zegana cycle); t_riot_drum is Rhythm of the Wild's second line, a grant_keyword static handing riot to nontoken creatures you control -- the printing riot had to be a *keyword* for, because a replacement is not grantable. t_riot_sapling is a printed 0/0 with riot: it is alive only if the counter is part of the arrival, so it is the 614.1c witness that no self_enters trigger could pass. t_riot_scribe reads the entering creature's power from the other side of the table, which pins that the counter is on before any enters trigger looks. t_riot_plain is the same brute with no riot, the control. t_riot_raise reanimates and t_riot_spawn makes a token -- the non-cast arrival and the nontoken exclusion.
